en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Selaco's Major Update Lands November 13

entries.headline: Gift Ten Industry announces みんなで探せ！マドリカ不動産の出口 as a local co-op puzzle party game
entries.summary: The newest Madorica Real Estate series game shifts to local cooperative play on Nintendo Switch 2. One player briefly studies a route, then communicates with the group as they assemble an escape path on paper; release is planned for late 2026.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON relayed the developer announcement and its platform and gameplay details. The announcement date is known, but no hour-level time was provided.
entries.timeNote: The developer announcement was dated October 31, 2026; release is planned for late 2026.

entries.headline: Ryosuke Yamada appointed an official Final Fantasy XIV reporter as a new commercial enters production
entries.summary: At Final Fantasy XIV Fan Festival 2026 in Tokyo, Ryosuke Yamada was named an official reporter who will introduce the game from a beginner's perspective. Production of a new commercial featuring him was also announced.
entries.verification: 4Gamer's opened stage report explicitly states the appointment and commercial production; no air date is inferred.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 1, 2026.

entries.headline: Honkai: Star Rail announces a tie-in with four Japanese weekly manga magazines
entries.summary: The official Honkai: Star Rail account announced a two-week campaign across the back covers of Weekly Shonen Jump, Weekly Shonen Sunday, Weekly Shonen Magazine, and Weekly Shonen Champion.
entries.verification: Denfaminicogamer directly relayed the official November 1 announcement and named all four magazines; specific issue numbers are not inferred.
entries.timeNote: The official announcement was dated November 1, 2026.

entries.headline: Selaco's The Machines of War update launches November 13
entries.summary: Altered Orbit Studios is preparing The Machines of War for November 13. The update adds the second of three planned chapters, 19 campaign maps and roughly six to eight hours of content, alongside broad lighting, particle, navigation and control reworks; old saves will not remain compatible.
entries.verification: PC Gamer relayed Altered Orbit Studios' update details and date; the article author's opinions are excluded.
entries.timeNote: The update is scheduled for November 13, 2026.

entries.headline: Warhorse confirms cyberattack as anonymous sources claim Kingdom Come development has halted
entries.summary: Warhorse Studios confirmed a cyberattack on October 27 and unauthorized access on October 31. An AUTOMATON report also cited anonymous sources claiming development has completely stopped, a point Warhorse has not publicly confirmed.
entries.verification: The opened report separates Warhorse's public security statements from anonymous claims about development impact; no release delay is inferred.
entries.timeNote: The cyberattack was disclosed October 27, with an unauthorized-access update on October 31; the alleged development halt has no verified timestamp.

entries.headline: Tales of Destiny's original release yields a new glitch-free way to recruit Lilith after roughly 29 years
entries.summary: Long-running guide site Majestic Fantasian reported a method in the original release of Tales of Destiny that formally recruits Lilith without using the known Lilith glitch. AUTOMATON described it as a discovery made roughly 29 years after launch.
entries.verification: The opened report distinguishes the new method from the existing glitch; the procedural steps are not reproduced because the packet does not provide them in full.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 10:02 Beijing time on November 2, 2026.

entries.headline: The Twilight Project strands an American content creator in a Thai forest haunted by nightly anomalies
entries.summary: 4Gamer interviewed Teapot Studio at gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show 2026 about its survival-horror project. The game follows an American content creator who becomes lost in a Thai forest and encounters strange phenomena each night.
entries.verification: The opened interview headline and lead establish the developer, genre, protagonist and setting; no platform or release date is added.
entries.timeNote: The interview was published on November 1, 2026.

entries.headline: The Last Debut puts players behind the scenes of an idol survival show
entries.summary: GAMEINDY's PC game The Last Debut casts the player as the executive producer of an idol survival audition program, balancing ratings-oriented production choices against the condition of its trainees.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer headline and lead establish the publisher, PC platform, program premise and player role; no release window is added.
entries.timeNote: The feature was published on November 1, 2026.
